  - heading "Open Foundry from its link" [level=1]
  - paragraph: "This tab doesn't have Foundry's key. Foundry gives each tab its own key, and only through a link it opens for you. To open Foundry, run this in a terminal on this computer:"
  - text: node "/home/user/workflow-foundry/.claude/worktrees/wf_c7946468-203-16/app/cli.mjs" open --workspace "/tmp/journey-p2-next-day-RIvx5x"
  - paragraph: "Run it in your own terminal, not through a coding agent: the link it opens works once, within a minute, and Foundry shows it only to a person's terminal."
  - paragraph: If nothing opens, Foundry isn't running. Today someone technical has to start it again after the computer restarts.

    - link "Help":
      - /url: "#/help"
